title: Etale-to-proetale comparison of the canonical direct-image projection morphism
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite discrete commutative ring and $p:X\to Y$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes. Work on small representatives of the etale and pro-etale sites in a common universe with ordinary uncompleted constant-$A$ module derived categories [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Put $F_T=\nu_T^*$, $u=p_{\mathrm{et}}^*$, $v=p_{\mathrm{proet}}^*$, $R_e=Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}$ and $R_p=Rp_{\mathrm{proet},*}$. Use the canonical pullback comparison $a:F_Xu\xrightarrow{\sim}vF_Y$ [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], the tensor comparisons $t_T:F_T(B\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}C)\xrightarrow{\sim}F_TB\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}F_TC$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], and the normalized direct-image mate $b_B:F_YR_eB\xrightarrow{\sim}R_pF_XB$ for $B\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate].

Let $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $N\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, and assume $L=K\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}uN$ also lies in $D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$. Let $\pi_e$ and $\pi_p$ denote the canonical projection morphisms at $(K,N)$ and $(F_XK,F_YN)$, respectively: each is the adjoint transpose of the pullback tensor comparison followed by counit tensor identity [def-kun-projection-formula-map, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]. Set $h=(1\otimes a_N)\circ t_{X;K,uN}$. Then, as maps from $F_Y(R_eK\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}N)$ to $R_p(F_XK\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}vF_YN)$,
$$R_p(h)\circ b_L\circ F_Y(\pi_e)=\pi_p\circ(b_K\otimes1)\circ t_{Y;R_eK,N}.$$
The equality is natural in the displayed inputs. Properness, constructibility, finite Tor amplitude and invertibility of the projection morphisms are not assumed.

proof.text: Take the mate of comparisonOpenDerivedPullbackIso.inv with respect to the existing unbounded derived adjunctions. At a bounded-below object K, include fixedComparisonDirectImageMatePlus_counit into the unbounded category. The formula map_restrictFullyFaithful_counit_app expresses each included bounded-below counit as the unbounded counit after the rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility map and the exact-pullback comparison. The included fixedComparisonPullbackPlus is the termwise localized square, by the inclusion formulas for composition and natural isomorphisms. Naturality of the exact-pullback comparison and cancellation of its isomorphisms then show that the unbounded mate at K equals the explicit normalized bounded-below mate in the statement. This is a full local proof by injectivity of the unbounded adjunction Hom equivalence; apply it at K and L.

proof.text: Apply the already proved general map_rightAdjointProjectionMap_comp_mateEquiv to the tensor-compatible fixed-coefficient square of step 1. The two rightAdjointProjectionMap terms are definitionally the published etale and pro-etale projection transformations. The target identification in the general identity is definitionally comparisonOpenTensorIso, namely t_X followed by tensoring comparisonOpenDerivedPullbackIso.hom. Substitute the two normalized mate equalities of step 2 to obtain exactly the two displayed component formulas.

source.place: Tag 0E48, remark-compatible-with-diagram; fixed-coefficient categorical mate realization

proof.text: Construct the common natural transformation by composing the horizontal tensor comparison, the natural mate tensored with identity, and the pro-etale projection transformation, first as curried bifunctors and then using Functor.uncurry.map. Restrict its components to the full subcategory of admissible pairs. Naturality follows from the composed natural transformation and functoriality of the horizontal pullback. Step 3 gives its other component formula. The three interface theorems follow by reflexivity.
